# Lumina Voice

> Free offline-first Urdu audiobook, ghazal and audio-drama app for web and Android.
> Streams public audio directly from Archive.org, saves episodes for offline listening, syncs the
> listener's place between devices, supports saved subtitles, and installs as a PWA or native APK.
> Radio is paused.

Developer: AL ASAR JADEED · WEBSITE: www.alasarjadeed.com · Email: luminamyai@gmail.com
Author: Lumina My Ai · Website: www.alasarjadeed.com · Email: luminamyai@gmail.com

Lumina Voice is a private, client-only React application. There is no first-party API server.
All backends are optional. The device does the work: local state, on-device voice, an
Archive.org-only catalogue and a service-worker cache for downloaded audio. Advertising is
kept in a separate data file and the APK ships only `ad-*` audio.

## Launch
- Static PWA served by nginx on localhost (private LAN access is configured locally)
- No VS Code needed: `docker-compose up -d --build`; desktop icon `Lumina Voice.desktop` runs `scripts/open-lumina.sh` to start the container if stopped and open the app
- No streaming server, database, API key or paid provider is required
- Admin → Cloud catalogue manages Archive.org links in Supabase with a published/draft switch; a 15-minute cron publishes metadata-only `/catalogue.json` that the web app and tablet pull (audio still streams directly from archive.org)
- Observability: pino logs; Sentry alerts disabled without a DSN
- Natural on-device Urdu speech: Android TTS voice pack, Urdu digits/punctuation and human-like pauses (no key, no network)

## Functions (SEO/AEO summary)

- Free Urdu audiobook, ghazal and audio-drama player: browse curated Archive.org titles and stream direct MP3/Opus audio.
- Offline listening: download episodes to the device; the app shell, saved position and subtitles remain available without a connection.
- Import Archive.org links: only items with direct `archive.org/download/...` audio URLs pass the content policy.
- Cross-device sync: library, playback positions, history, imported titles, artwork, subtitles and settings ride in Supabase `user_state`; no audio bytes are uploaded.
- Installable PWA and native Android APK (Capacitor 8); media keys, safe-area layout and a small ~6 MB APK.
- Saved subtitles in Urdu, English and Arabic with Auto/Off selection; on-device Urdu TTS for UI prompts.

## Accounts and saved data

- Anyone may create a free profile with their own email in the app; no invitation is required. The public media catalogue comes from Archive.org and every account sees the same public titles.
- Only `info@alasarjadeed.com` is the operator/admin across web, tablet and Supabase. All other emails are listeners, even if a profile row claims another role.
- A listener's library, playback positions, history, imported Archive titles, artwork, subtitles and settings are stored in that account's own Supabase `user_state` row. RLS limits read/write to `auth.uid() = user_id`, so another account cannot read or edit them.
- Ratings and reviews are public to read, but only their author can edit or delete them. No audio bytes are uploaded or stored in Supabase; only metadata syncs.
- On a shared device, sign out before handing it over. A device's local browser cache can still hold the last listener's metadata until it is cleared.

## Radio feature — PAUSED (2026-11-17)
- Public live radio is disabled until broadcast resources are available. Radio source is kept intact for a one-switch relaunch.
- Feature flag: `VITE_RADIO_ENABLED` (default `false`, set in `.env.production` / `.env.example`). `src/config/features.js` exports `RADIO_ENABLED`.
- When `false`: no Radio nav tab or `/radio` route (old `/radio` redirects to `/`), no embed page, no Home/Site radio links, no Broadcast Studio (`/admin` opens the radio-free Device Admin for admins), no radio voice commands or alerts, no external-stream stats/embeds, and no broadcast-server requests. `loadStreamConfig()` reports `enabled: false`; `useNowPlaying`, `playExternal`, `playRadio`, `playBroadcast`, AzuraCast API and show reminders are no-ops.
- All radio code (Broadcast Studio, bundled Sada Bahar desk, AzuraCast config, embeds) stays in the source tree, fully gated — nothing radio-related runs while the flag is off.
- Relaunch: set `VITE_RADIO_ENABLED=true`, rebuild (`npm run build` / `docker compose up -d --build`) and radio pages, tabs, embeds and stream calls return unchanged.
- Verified: `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`; browser smoke test confirmed no radio links, `/radio` → `/`, and no broadcast-server requests.

## Huawei AppGallery release
- Public privacy policy: `https://www.alasarjadeed.com/privacy`; Settings → Privacy and Account → Delete account.
- Store build uses `npm run build:store`, which generates `.env.store` with bundled `/catalogue.json`, radio off, broadcast keys blanked and no cleartext LAN fetch.
- Signed release AAB/APK uses an out-of-repo keystore; listing and checklist live in `docs/store/huawei-appgallery.md`.
